triggers.name: new_csv_line
triggers.title: New line in CSV file
triggers.description: New line in CSV file in OneDrive
triggers.help: On recipe start, trigger will pick up all existing lines in the provided CSV file. Each line will be processed as a single trigger event. Subsequently, new lines must be appended to the end of the file to be picked up properly.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: file_id
input.label: File path
input.hint: Full file path including extension and folders, e.g. folder 1/file name.csv

input.name: column_separator
input.label: Column separator
input.hint: Delimiter separating the values

triggers.name: new_event_trigger
triggers.title: New event
triggers.help: Fetches trigger events as soon as they occur.

input.name: folder_path
input.label: Folder path
input.hint: Provide folder path, e.g. folder 1/folder 2

input.name: include_subfolders
input.label: Monitor subfolders?
input.hint: If No , only the parent folder will be monitored, subfolders will not monitored for new activities. If Yes , subfolders will be monitored for new activities too, on top of the parent folder. However, …

input.name: event_type
input.label: Monitor for files or folders
input.hint: Select whether to monitor files, folders or both

input.name: activity_type
input.label: Activity to monitor
input.hint: Choose one or more activities to monitor

triggers.name: new_file
triggers.title: New file
triggers.help: Triggers when a new file is added in the selected folder. Subfolders will not be monitored. Checks for new events every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: folder_path
input.label: Folder
input.hint: Select folder to monitor for files. Subfolders will not be monitored.

triggers.name: new_folder
triggers.title: New folder
triggers.help: Triggers when a new folder is added in the selected folder. Subfolders will not be monitored. Checks for new events every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: folder_path
input.label: Folder
input.hint: Select folder to monitor for files. Subfolders will not be monitored.

triggers.name: updated_file
triggers.title: New/updated file
triggers.help: Triggers when a new file is added or existing file is updated in the selected folder. Subfolders will not be monitored. Checks for new events every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: folder_path
input.label: Folder
input.hint: Select folder to monitor for files. Subfolders will not be monitored.

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own OneDrive action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your OneDrive connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_folder
actions.title: Create folder
actions.help: Creates a new folder in drive with a specified parent item or path, If already a folder exists with the same name, a new folder will be created with different name.

input.name: folder_name
input.label: Folder name
input.hint: Enter folder name.

input.name: folder_path
input.label: Folder path
input.hint: Provide folder path in which new folder has to be created, e.g. folder 1/folder 2 . If left empty folder will be created in root folder.

actions.name: create_permission
actions.title: Add permission
actions.description: Add permission to a file or folder in Microsoft OneDrive
actions.help: Add permission to a file or folder for the specified recipents in Onedrive.

input.name: item_id
input.label: File/folder ID
input.hint: Provide file or folder ID. Example: 01G65C3RKY7QJD67NCMVAYKVFGW3KBGK75 .

input.name: roles
input.label: Role
input.hint: The type of permission. Allowed values: read or write .

input.name: recipients
input.label: Recipients
input.hint: Only one of these values is required.

input.name: message
input.label: Message
input.hint: A plain text formatted message that is included in the sharing invitation. Maximum length 2000 characters.

input.name: requireSignIn
input.label: Require sign in
input.hint: Specifies whether the recipient of the invitation is required to sign-in to view the shared item.

input.name: sendInvitation
input.label: Send invitation
input.hint: If true , a sharing link is sent to the recipient. Otherwise, a permission is granted directly without sending a notification.

actions.name: delete_file_or_folder
actions.title: Delete file or folder
actions.description: Delete file or folder in Microsoft OneDrive
actions.help: Note that this action removes the specified file/folder to the recycle bin and does not permanently delete it. To delete file or folder from a folder that is shared with you, enter the ID of the folder in the Drive ID field. The Drive ID field can be found in the optional fields.

input.name: shared_drive_id
input.label: Drive ID
input.hint: Provide the drive ID from which you want to delete the file or folder. Drive ID can be found in the OneDrive URL as the cid parameter. E.g., in 'https://onedrive.live.com/?id=244DDFC44A57%21103&cid=24…

input.name: file_or_folder
input.label: Delete file or folder?
input.hint: Specify the object to delete.

actions.name: delete_permission
actions.title: Remove permission
actions.description: Remove permission for a file or folder in Microsoft OneDrive
actions.help: Removes permission for a file or folder in Onedrive.

input.name: item_id
input.label: File/folder ID
input.hint: Provide file or folder ID. Example: 01G65C3RKY7QJD67NCMVAYKVFGW3KBGK75 .

input.name: permission_id
input.label: Permission ID
input.hint: Provide permission ID. Example: aTowIy5mfG1lbWJlcnNoaXB8ZGVtb0B3b3JrYXRvei5vbm1pY3Jvc29mdC5jb20 .

actions.name: download_file
actions.title: Download File
actions.description: Download file contents in Microsoft OneDrive
actions.help: This action downloads contents of a file in Microsoft OneDrive. File contents can be used in subsequent recipe steps to upload the file into another app. There is no fixed limit on file size. Maximum file size depends on if the upload can finish within the job timeout limit. Trying to download a fol…

input.name: shared_drive_id
input.label: Drive ID
input.hint: Provide the drive ID from which you want to download the file.Drive ID can be found in the OneDrive URL as the cid parameter. E.g., in 'https://onedrive.live.com/?id=244DDFC44A57%21103&cid=24C9A8FC44A…

input.name: item_id
input.label: File ID
input.hint: Provide file ID. Example: 01G65C3RKY7QJD67NCMVAYKVFGW3KBGK75 .

input.name: chunks_number
input.label: Chunk size (multiples of 320KB)
input.hint: Configure this to optimize throughput. Larger chunk size will increase throughput, but may hit API limit. The value entered will be multiplied by 320KB. Default is 5 ie. 1600 KB. Learn more

actions.name: list_files_folders
actions.title: List files and folders
actions.description: List files and folders in Microsoft OneDrive
actions.help: List files and folders in the selected parent folder. Items in subfolders will not be listed. To list files and folders from a folder that is shared with you, enter the ID of the folder in the Drive ID field. The Drive ID field can be found in the optional fields.

input.name: shared_drive_id
input.label: Drive ID
input.hint: Provide the drive ID from which you want to list files and folder. Drive ID can be found in the OneDrive URL as the cid parameter. E.g., in 'https://onedrive.live.com/?id=244DDFC44A57%21103&cid=24C9A8…

input.name: folder_path
input.label: Folder path
input.hint: Provide folder path, e.g. folder 1/folder 2 .

input.name: list_type
input.label: List files or folders?
input.hint: Select whether to list files, folders or both

actions.name: list_permission
actions.title: List permissions
actions.description: List permissions for a file or folder in Microsoft OneDrive
actions.help: List permissions for a file or folder in Onedrive.

input.name: item_id
input.label: File/folder ID
input.hint: Provide file or folder ID. Example: 01G65C3RKY7QJD67NCMVAYKVFGW3KBGK75 .

actions.name: search_files_new
actions.title: Search files
actions.help: Action will search partially when file name , metadata and file content are used in search query field. For exact match, search using file name followed with extension . Search is performed on the selected folder and its subfolders.

actions.name: upload_file
actions.title: Upload file via file content
actions.description: Upload file via file content in Microsoft OneDrive
actions.help: Upload a file by providing the file contents. Max file size of 4MB.

input.name: folder_path
input.label: Folder
input.hint: Select folder to upload files to

input.name: filename
input.label: File name
input.hint: File name with extensions, e.g. New csv file.csv . New data will overwrite existing file with the same name and extension.

input.name: body
input.label: File contents in text or binary format

actions.name: upload_file_from_url
actions.title: Upload file from URL
actions.description: Upload file from URL to Microsoft OneDrive
actions.help: Upload a file by providing as input the public URL where the file can be found. Action will fail if the file name provided already exists.

input.name: folder_path
input.label: Folder
input.hint: Select the folder where new file will be uploaded

input.name: url
input.label: Source URL
input.hint: Upload file from this URL

input.name: filename
input.label: File name
input.hint: File name with extensions, e.g. New csv file.csv . New data will overwrite existing file with the same name and extension.

actions.name: upload_file_session
actions.title: Upload large file via session
actions.description: Upload large file via file session to Microsoft OneDrive
actions.help: This action uploads a file to Microsoft OneDrive. There is no fixed limit on file size. Maximum file size depends on if the upload can finish within the job timeout limit.

input.name: folder_path
input.label: Folder
input.hint: Select folder to upload files to

input.name: filename
input.label: File name
input.hint: File name with extensions, e.g. New csv file.csv . New data will overwrite existing file with the same name and extension.

input.name: file_size
input.label: File size
input.hint: Enter the size of the file (in bytes)

input.name: body
input.label: File contents in text or binary format

input.name: chunks_number
input.label: Chunk size (multiples of 320KB)
input.hint: Configure this to optimize throughput. Larger chunk size will increase throughput, but may hit API limit. The value entered will be multiplied by 320KB. Default is 5 ie. 1600 KB. Learn more
